incentive_value_usd: Annualized clearing price approximately $217/MW-day (roughly 10x PY2024/25's approximately $21/MW-day); Summer 2025 seasonal price reached $666.50/MW-day the highest-reliability-risk season
event_limits: First Planning Year under MISO's seasonal PRA construct (Summer/Fall/Winter/Spring) and the RBDC continuous demand curve

incentive_structure: $/MW-day seasonal capacity clearing price set at auction under the RBDC
incentive_value_usd: $123/MW-day annualized for LRZ 9
event_limits: Delivery period June 1 2026 to May 31 2027

incentive_structure: $/MW-day seasonal capacity clearing price set at auction under the RBDC
incentive_value_usd: $126/MW-day annualized for North/Central (LRZ 1-7) down 42% year over year; a 4-hour battery's capacity revenue fell from approximately $75/kW-yr in 2025/26 to approximately $44/kW-yr in 2026/27 with Summer alone contributing about $37/kW-yr; seasonal breakdown Fall $34/MW-day Winter $36/MW-day Spring $8/MW-day
event_limits: Delivery period June 1 2026 to May 31 2027; second year under the RBDC; duration beyond 4 hours adds no incremental capacity accreditation in MISO

program_name: 2026/2027 Planning Resource Auction Results - South (LRZ 8 and 10)
incentive_structure: $/MW-day seasonal capacity clearing price set at auction under the RBDC
incentive_value_usd: $116/MW-day annualized for the South sub-region (LRZ 8 and 10) due to transfer constraints limiting import capability from MISO North
event_limits: Delivery period June 1 2026 to May 31 2027

program_name: Day-Ahead and Real-Time Energy Arbitrage by Trading Hub
incentive_structure: Battery revenue captured via top-bottom LMP spreads at MISO's major pricing hubs including Indiana Hub Michigan Hub Minnesota Hub and Illinois Hub
incentive_value_usd: Four-hour real-time spreads at Indiana Hub exceeded day-ahead spreads by 148% in February 2026 during Winter Storm Fern with outsized BESS arbitrage opportunities concentrated at the Indiana and Michigan hubs; a full-year 2025 hub-by-hub average spread figure was not independently confirmed
event_limits: No MISO-imposed cap on participation; driven by weather-related volatility such as winter storms and by transmission congestion between MISO North and MISO South

incentive_structure: FERC Order 841-compliant model allowing ESRs to bid into energy ancillary services (Regulation Spin Supplemental STR) and capacity (PRA) markets as a distinct asset class able to set both supply and demand offers
event_limits: Minimum 0.1 MW injection/withdrawal capability; must comply with Setpoint Instructions; appropriate metering required; ESRs interconnected at the distribution system require an Attachment HHH filing coordinating with the Distribution Company and retail regulator
tariff_schedule: MISO Tariff Module E; Attachment HHH
stackable_with: Regulating Reserve;Spinning Reserve;Planning Resource Auction;Energy Arbitrage

program_name: Load Modifying Resource (LMR) - Planning Resource Auction Participation
incentive_structure: Capacity accreditation credited toward a Load Serving Entity's Planning Reserve Margin Requirement in the PRA; historically split into LMR-DR (demand reduction) and LMR-BTMG (behind-the-meter generation) sub-types with UCAP value based on nameplate/historical performance
incentive_value_usd: Legacy accreditation approached near-full nameplate credit; under the new DLOL (Direct Loss-of-Load) availability-based accreditation methodology indicative results for PY2025/2026 showed accreditation factors well below legacy nameplate-based values for many LMRs materially cutting their effective PRA capacity revenue
event_limits: DLOL-based accreditation approved by FERC as part of MISO's Resource Availability and Need (RAN) initiative; indicative informational DLOL accreditation published starting PY2025/2026 PRA with full binding implementation targeted for PY2028/2029; ties accreditation to real-time historical availability during the tightest hours rather than nameplate capacity

incentive_structure: $/MWh clearing price paid to resources providing AGC-following regulation capacity
incentive_value_usd: Day-ahead Regulation clearing price averaged $17.34/MWh in 2025 up 59% from $10.91/MWh in 2023
event_limits: Continuous AGC-following signal; battery performance scored on tracking accuracy similar to PJM's regulation product

incentive_structure: 30-minute reserve product introduced under MISO's 2025 shortage-pricing and reserve reforms to improve flexibility procurement
incentive_value_usd: Clearing price data published in IMM Quarterly Reports beginning with Fall 2023 through 2025 but a specific average $/MWh value was not independently confirmed
event_limits: 30-minute deployment product newly launched alongside the 2025 shortage pricing reforms

incentive_structure: $/MWh clearing price for synchronized 10-minute contingency reserve
incentive_value_usd: Day-ahead Spinning Reserve averaged $4.32/MWh in 2025
event_limits: 10-minute contingency reserve; resource must be synchronized to the grid

incentive_structure: $/MWh clearing price for non-synchronized 10-minute reserve
incentive_value_usd: Day-ahead Supplemental Reserve averaged roughly $1/MWh in 2025
event_limits: 10-minute non-synchronized reserve deployment

program_name: Economic Load Response (Day-Ahead and Real-Time Demand Bidding)
incentive_structure: Curtailment Service Providers bid demand reductions into day-ahead or real-time energy market; paid at cleared nodal LMP for the bid hours
incentive_value_usd: Paid at nodal LMP; composite energy offers above $1000/MWh and up to $2000/MWh face additional screening under Manual 11 offer-cap rules
event_limits: Voluntary participation; no PJM-declared emergency required; bid must clear like a generation offer; subject to a Net Benefits Test

program_name: Emergency Load Response Program (Full Program and Energy Only Options)
incentive_structure: $/MWh energy credit paid at real-time LMP for verified load reduction during PJM-declared emergencies
incentive_value_usd: Paid at real-time LMP for curtailed MWh; no fixed $/MW-day payment
event_limits: Called only during PJM-declared Capacity Emergency Pre-Emergency or Maximum Emergency conditions per Manual 13; Full Program participants must curtail when directed while Energy Only participants respond voluntarily

incentive_structure: Load that automatically and verifiably responds to real-time LMP signals is treated as a capacity resource in RPM reducing net peak load forecasts and load's capacity obligation
incentive_value_usd: Reflected as a reduction in the Load Serving Entity's forecasted peak demand and capacity obligation rather than a direct per-MW payment to the end customer
event_limits: Requires real-time telemetry and metering to demonstrate price-responsive load reduction correlated with LMP; participant must register a PRD Plan with PJM
tariff_schedule: OATT Attachment K-Appendix Section 6; Manual 11 Section 12

program_name: FERC Order 2222 Distributed Energy Resource Aggregation
incentive_structure: DER aggregations bid into energy capacity and ancillary markets as a single resource under a no-commitment aggregation model administered through Curtailment Service Providers/Market Participants
incentive_value_usd: Same clearing prices as the underlying wholesale capacity energy and ancillary markets apportioned across the DERs in the aggregation
event_limits: Minimum aggregation size as small as 100 kW (0.1 MW); DER aggregations under 10 MW participating only in the energy market are exempt from telemetry requirements; a 167 MW cap applies to multi-nodal aggregations; dual participation rules prevent the same DER capability from being counted in both a retail program and a wholesale aggregation simultaneously
tariff_schedule: OATT (Docket ER22-962); PJM compliance filing effective per FERC's July 25 2024 order

incentive_structure: $/MW-day UCAP capacity clearing price set at auction
incentive_value_usd: $269.92/MW-day RTO and most LDAs; BGE cleared at $466.35/MW-day; Dominion cleared at $444.26/MW-day for Delivery Year 2025/2026
event_limits: Delivery Year June 1 2025 to May 31 2026; 135684 MW UCAP cleared; 18.6% reserve margin

incentive_structure: $/MW-day UCAP capacity clearing price set at auction
incentive_value_usd: $329.17/MW-day UCAP RTO-wide (FERC price cap); all LDAs cleared at the cap; 134311 MW UCAP procured
event_limits: Delivery Year June 1 2026 to May 31 2027; price cap $329.17/MW-day and price floor $177.24/MW-day per Reliability Resource Initiative parameters

incentive_structure: $/MW-day UCAP capacity clearing price set at auction
incentive_value_usd: $333.44/MW-day UCAP RTO-wide (FERC price cap); 134479 MW UCAP procured; total cleared value approximately $16.4 billion
event_limits: Delivery Year June 1 2027 to May 31 2028; first auction where RTO-wide cleared capacity fell short of the reliability requirement (short by 6623 MW)

program_name: Capacity Performance Non-Performance Charge and Bonus (Performance Assessment)
incentive_structure: Non-Performance Charge Rate applied per MW of shortfall during Performance Assessment Intervals; funds bonus payments to over-performing resources; rate derived from Net CONE divided by an EFORd-adjusted reserve factor
incentive_value_usd: Aggregated Non-Performance Charges across 2025 Performance Assessment events estimated by PJM at $1 billion to $2 billion system-wide; per-resource Non-Performance Charge Rate not independently confirmed for current Delivery Year
event_limits: Assessed per 5-minute interval during any Performance Assessment Hour (Emergency or Pre-Emergency Load Management event); Stop-Loss provisions cap annual non-performance exposure at a multiple of a resource's weekly capacity revenue
tariff_schedule: OATT Attachment DD Section 10A; Manual 18 Section 4

incentive_structure: Value captured from charging during low-LMP hours and discharging during high-LMP hours measured as the daily top-4-hour minus bottom-4-hour (TB4) spread net of round-trip efficiency losses
incentive_value_usd: PJM-wide average TB4 spread rose from about $46699/MW-yr in 2024 to about $69375/MW-yr in 2025 (a 49% year-over-year increase); highest spreads concentrated in Northern Virginia and Eastern Maryland (Dominion BGE PEPCO zones); lowest spreads in New Jersey zones (PSEG JCPL) due to export constraints
event_limits: Captured through day-ahead and real-time LMP differentials; no PJM-imposed cap on participation; subject to nodal congestion and export limits

incentive_structure: $/MWh payment for offline or fast-start capacity deliverable within 10 minutes co-optimized with energy and Synchronized Reserve
incentive_value_usd: Not independently confirmed for 2026; cleared jointly with Synchronized Reserve under PJM's 2023 reserve price formation reform
event_limits: 10-minute response requirement; consolidated Tier 1/Tier 2 procurement aligned across Day-Ahead and Real-Time markets under the 2023 reserve reform

incentive_structure: $/MW-day capacity payment cleared alongside generation in BRA; same CP performance obligation applies
incentive_value_usd: Same cleared BRA price as generation capacity ($329.17/MW-day RTO for 2026/2027 DY)
event_limits: Annual DR must be available year-round; Limited DR covers June-Sept weekdays; Extended Summer DR covers May-Sept; all DR products require minimum 10-consecutive-hour sustained reduction capability since Capacity Performance eliminated Base Capacity
tariff_schedule: OATT Attachment DD Section 5.5A; Manual 18 Section 4
stackable_with: Economic Load Response;Emergency Load Response;Synchronized Reserve

incentive_structure: Capability payment equals Cleared MW times RMCCP times Performance Score; Performance payment equals Cleared MW times Mileage Ratio times RMPCP times Performance Score; plus a Lost Opportunity Cost payment; RegA is the slower steady signal historically used by thermal generation
incentive_value_usd: 2023 average Regulation Market Clearing Price (RMCP) was approximately $21.08/MW; RegA generally clears at a lower dollar-per-effective-MW rate than RegD
event_limits: Continuous 5-minute AGC dispatch signal; performance scored every 5 minutes on precision delay and correlation; RegA/RegD dual-signal design is being replaced by a single unified signal starting October 2025 with a full Regulation-Up/Regulation-Down split by October 2026

incentive_structure: Performance payment equals Cleared MW times Mileage Ratio times RMPCP times Performance Score; Capability payment equals Cleared MW times RMCCP times Performance Score where RMCCP equals RMCP minus RMPCP; plus Lost Opportunity Cost equals Estimated Missed Energy Revenue times Performance Score
incentive_value_usd: RegD has historically driven over 80% of PJM battery revenue; in Q1 2025 97% of cleared RegD MW had $0 effective-cost self-scheduled bids and batteries scored 91-100% performance in 92% of operating hours; RegD's mileage-based rate per effective MW has been more than double RegA's in some months
event_limits: Continuous 5-minute fast-following signal optimized for batteries; the Marginal Benefit Factor used to clear the market versus the Mileage Ratio used to pay for it creates a payment premium the PJM Market Monitor argues overstates RegD's system value; a single unified signal replaces RegA/RegD starting October 2025 with a Reg-Up/Reg-Down split by October 2026
tariff_schedule: OATT Schedule 1; Manual 28 Regulation Redesign sections

incentive_structure: $/MW-day UCAP capacity payment cleared in Base Residual Auction; single year-round CP product
incentive_value_usd: Set by BRA clearing price (see BRA rows); bounded by FERC-approved Market Seller Offer Cap tied to Net ACR
event_limits: Must perform during all Performance Assessment Hours across the Delivery Year; 24x365 obligation; no seasonal or hourly call cap

incentive_structure: $/MWh payment for reserve capacity deliverable within 30 minutes
incentive_value_usd: Not independently confirmed for 2026; published via PJM Data Miner 2 Day-Ahead Ancillary Service LMPs feed
event_limits: 30-minute response requirement

incentive_structure: $/MWh capacity payment cleared in the 10-minute co-optimized reserve market; Tier 1 is spare energy from online resources deliverable within 10 minutes while Tier 2 is called only when Tier 1 is insufficient
incentive_value_usd: Clearing prices vary by hour and reserve zone and were not independently confirmed for 2026; PJM added a 30% adder to the Synchronized Reserve requirement in May 2023 after under-performance during reserve events
event_limits: Must respond within 10 minutes and sustain for the event duration; deployed via a PJM-declared Synchronized Reserve Event
